THE PROBLEM

Great projects can stall when the right people are missing.

Students working on personal projects may lack the skills needed to complete every part of their work. Finding people with complementary abilities often means searching across several communities, while students eager to contribute struggle to find suitable opportunities.

01 / SCATTERED PLATFORMS

Too many places to search

Project posts, feedback and collaboration requests are spread across communities built for different purposes.

02 / MISSING SKILLS

Not every project has a full team

A developer may need a designer; a designer may need someone who can build the application. Those connections are not always easy to find.

03 / MISSED OPPORTUNITIES

Students struggle to get involved

Students want to gain practical experience, but often do not know where to begin or how to find beginner-friendly project opportunities.

MEET THE SOLUTION

A centralized space for sharing projects, finding collaborators and exchanging feedback.

Make it clear what you're building and what skills your project needs. Skiro helps students find relevant opportunities, express interest in joining a team and work toward completing projects together.

01 / SHARE

Share your project

Publish your idea, goals, progress and the skills or roles you need.

02 / DISCOVER

Discover projects

Browse student projects and find opportunities that match your interests and abilities.

03 / COLLABORATE

Start building together

Show interest in a role, connect with creators and contribute real work to the team.

04 / FEEDBACK

Share feedback

Exchange suggestions, improve projects and get another perspective on your work.
